F1.signature: left hand passes above the puzzle before descending to the ring

F2.signature: left hand sweeps through the positive-Y outer corridor

F3.signature: left hand retracts through the negative-Y corridor before approaching

classic_circle.qualification: original exact baseline has gravity and half-timestep evidence; changed instances require new verification

deferred_prototypes.waisted: geometric witness only; surface grasp and physical pairing required
deferred_prototypes.broad_u: geometric witness only; surface grasp and physical pairing required
deferred_prototypes.ellipse: geometric witness only; controlled ring phase and physical pairing required

proposal_domain.coupling: all puzzle dimensions including chain and target ring scale together; robot stays full size; re-solve pregrasp/fold IK and adapt guide; per-instance physics mandatory
proposal_domain.sampling: Conditional on each family paired anchor, clipped to these outer limits

visual_gate.signature_segment: entry corridor ending at the designed waypoint; subsequent wrist alignment may adapt

acceptance.on_failure: retain rejected attempt and reason; retry within the same family; bounded exhaustion raises
acceptance.split_group: prototype_id (or family_id for held-out motion); never split near-identical descendants by seed alone
